name: GaitGuard
tagline: A wearable that learns a patient's correct movement from a therapist's demo and buzzes when reps drift.
problem: Rehab patients repeat exercises incorrectly at home without feedback.
solution: Sensors capture a therapist-guided correct motion to build a personal model; later reps are compared and haptic feedback signals deviations, with mobile and desktop apps.
demo_moment: Team-described: perform a rep wrongly and feel the buzz.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Third Place Overall” and “Built With Zed” among 212 submissions.
Personal baseline instead of a generic model.

lessons: Calibrate to the individual for credible health feedback.
